your_book:
Monday's session was a mixed bag for Jaleel's book, with the overall unrealized gain sitting at +3.51%. The day's clearest winner was Boston Scientific (BSX), which surged +3.12% — notable given that an elevated risk flag remains open on that name following a guidance slash that trimmed FY26 growth expectations down to 7–8.5%. A single strong session doesn't repair a thesis under pressure; the next checkpoint isn't until October 28. NVIDIA (NVDA) added +1.48%, a modest recovery, though the risk flag on export controls and AI-capex sentiment remains live heading into earnings. AutoZone (AZO) ticked up +0.99% and Adobe (ADBE) edged +0.44%, both quiet but constructive.

The drag came from Abbott (ABT), the book's largest weight at 10.5%, which fell -1.88% today — a meaningful move for a top position, even if ABT still carries a healthy +27.6% unrealized gain. Equifax (EFX) was Monday's worst performer at -2.67%, though its small weight limits the damage. S&P Global (SPGI) slipped -1.59%, and Danaher (DHR) gave back -1.16%.

The real drift concern remains Rocket Lab (RKLB): rated AVOID with a QARP of just 39.1, down -18.4% in the book, and still occupying a 6.3% weight — that's a meaningful allocation fighting against its own verdict. Zoetis (ZTS) and BSX are also underwater on cost basis while carrying Strong Buy ratings, meaning the thesis and price haven't reconciled yet. Watch LULU closely — earnings are due September 3, just days away, with Americas comps already running -5% for five straight quarters.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated, -18.4% in the hole, still 6.3% of book
attention.note: The verdict is AVOID and the QARP score (39.1) is the lowest in the book by a wide margin — holding a near-top-ten weight in a name the model explicitly flags for exit is a direct contradiction of the capital-preservation mandate.

attention.headline: Earnings September 3 with elevated guidance-cut flag live
attention.note: Five consecutive quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff margin pressure, and a stalled China business make this a binary event in days — the elevated risk flag demands a pre-earnings sizing decision, not a post-earnings reaction.

attention.headline: Largest weight dropped -1.88% today with EPS guide already trimmed
attention.note: At 10.5% of the book, ABT's daily move carries outsized impact, and the existing mild risk flag on a trimmed EPS outlook means any further negative newsflow before the October 13 update could compound quickly.

attention.headline: +3.12% session bounce doesn't close the guidance-slash overhang
attention.note: BSX rallied sharply today but remains in the red on cost basis (-1.5%) and carries an elevated flag — guidance was cut to flat through Q3, so today's move warrants scrutiny as a relief rally rather than thesis vindication before the October 28 print.
